render_error:
Failed to reach https://mermaid.ink API while trying to render your graph after 0 retries. To resolve this issue:
1. Check your internet connection and try again
2. Try with higher retry settings: `draw_mermaid_png(..., max_retries=5, retry_delay=2.0)`
3. Use the Pyppeteer rendering method which will render your graph locally in a browser: `draw_mermaid_png(..., draw_method=MermaidDrawMethod.PYPPETEER)`

workflow.aggregation_logic: Group members debate locally, representatives merge group summaries, and a shared final judge selects the final answer.
conditional_edges: group_dispatch -> group_debate_round (parallel Send fan-out) else group_controller
representative_dispatch -> representative_merge (parallel Send fan-out) else final_judge
workflow.dispatch_logic: Debate is local to groups until the controller emits representative-only summaries. Inter-group traffic is restricted to representative packets.

nodes.group_dispatch: Fan out the intra-group debate stage.

stopping_criteria: No meaningful change between group or representative revisions
